correctness.rationale: For the gamma=0 interior-interpolation Exner–Pekař quantum chain, the original un-divided secular equation has Bloch sin(theta) and cos(theta) coefficients. At 0<t<1 their prefactors outside cos(k l3)-cos(k l2) and sin(k l2)+sin(k l3) cannot vanish. With l2+l3=2pi their simultaneous zero forces sin(pi k)=0, so k=m>=1 integer. Substituting integer m into original displayed P6,P4,P2 gives respectively -72 ell^6(c-1)^2 S, -48 ell^4(c²-1) S, -8 ell²(c+1)² S where S=sin(m l1)sin²(m l3); hence the constant secular coefficient factors exactly -8 m² ell² S [3m² ell²(c-1)+(c+1)]². Its vanishing is precisely edge commensurability or 3m² ell² tan²(pi t/6)=1. Analytic Bloch direct-integral criterion equates positive-measure zero of fibers with point spectrum and conversely. Independently expanded the multivariate polynomial identity via SymPy; numerical checks cannot substitute for the full secular-equation argument. Endpoint t=1 and negative/zero energies are excluded.
